goal: For v0.4.0: let people move ArtiShare from the popup into a side panel and back (remembered), make Artifacts a list of rows that always picks up the current tab's artifact and is easy to remove from, and move Manage access from the bottom of the Share tab to an icon in the header.

features.description: Artifacts shows each artifact as its own row with a Remove (×) button, and links can still be pasted in any number
steps: Open the popup over a non-claude.ai page with nothing in Artifacts: see 'No artifacts yet. Open one and click + Current tab, or paste links below.' and a box labelled Artifacts with the placeholder 'Paste artifact links (one per line)'

Paste https://claude.ai/artifact/ExampleArtifactOne01, https://claude.ai/cowork/cse_01ExampleCoworkSession00?artifact=c0ffee00-1234-4abc-8def-000000000001#example and https://claude.ai/artifact/ExampleArtifactTwo02 on three lines: see three rows at once (the cowork link shown as https://claude.ai/artifact/QqHHsBLXBfYKJD5NqJ8PeY), the count reading 3, and the box empty again
Type https://claude.ai/artifact/ExampleArtifactThree3 and press Enter: a fourth row is added
Paste 'not a link' together with a valid link: the valid link becomes a row; 'not a link' stays in the box with 'Not artifact links: not a link'
Paste https://claude.ai/artifact/ExampleArtifactOne01 again: no second row; the existing row is briefly highlighted and the box says 'Already in the list'
See each row show its link on one line (cut off with … when long, the full link in a tooltip) and a × button named 'Remove https://claude.ai/artifact/…'
Tick a list and click Preview: the preview shows the same artifacts, in the same order as the rows

features.description: Removing an artifact is one click, can be undone, and works from the keyboard
steps: With three rows, click × on the second: it disappears at once, the count drops to 2, and 'Removed https://claude.ai/artifact/… · Undo' shows under the rows
Click Undo within 5 seconds: the row is back in its old place and the count is 3; without Undo, the message goes away after about 5 seconds
Press Tab from the top of the Share tab: focus reaches each × in order, with a visible focus ring; press Enter on the first: it is removed and focus moves to the next row's ×
Remove the last row with the keyboard: focus moves to the paste box, and the empty state 'No artifacts yet…' shows
Remove a row, close the popup and reopen it: the row is still gone (the list is saved like the rest of the draft)

features.description: Opening ArtiShare over an artifact adds it to Artifacts when it isn't there yet, marked 'This tab', the same for the second and third artifact as for the first; when it's already there nothing changes
steps: Make https://claude.ai/artifact/ExampleArtifactOne01 the active tab (in e2e, served by a route so nothing reaches claude.ai) and open the popup with no artifacts: see one row for it with a 'This tab' badge
Close the popup, make https://claude.ai/artifact/ExampleArtifactTwo02 the active tab and reopen: see two rows, One then Two, the count 2, and the 'This tab' badge now on Two only
Do the same with https://claude.ai/artifact/ExampleArtifactThree3: three rows, the badge on Three
Make Two the active tab again and reopen: still three rows, no second Two, the badge on Two
Make the cowork tab for an artifact already in the list the active tab (same artifact, other link): no new row, and that row gets the badge
Make a non-claude.ai page the active tab and reopen: the rows are unchanged and no row has the badge
Send a run from this form and let it finish, make an artifact the active tab and click Start a new share: see the fresh list holding only that tab's artifact

features.description: An artifact you removed isn't added back by itself, until you add it or start a new share
steps: Open the popup over https://claude.ai/artifact/ExampleArtifactOne01 (it is added), click × on it, close the popup and reopen it over the same tab: it is not added back, and no row has the badge
Click + Current tab: it is added back on purpose, with the badge; from then on it behaves like any other row
Remove One again, then open the popup over https://claude.ai/artifact/ExampleArtifactTwo02: Two is added (only the removed artifact is held back)
Remove One and click Undo: One is back and is treated as never removed
Remove One, send a run with the other rows and let it finish: after Start a new share, opening over One adds it again
Remove One, quit and restart the browser: opening over One adds it again (what was removed is kept with the draft, which lasts until the browser quits)

features.description: A Share draft from 0.3.0 and links typed but not yet added carry over into the new rows, and every existing spec passes with them
steps: Start from a profile holding a 0.3.0 Share draft (`artifactText` with two artifact links and the line 'not a link'): open the popup and see two rows, and 'not a link' in the box with its warning
Type a valid link into the box without pressing Enter: the Preview button already counts it; click Preview and see it included
Type a valid link without pressing Enter, close the popup and reopen it: the link is still there
Open the popup on the Share tab over a non-claude.ai page with no rows and no text, tick a list and click Preview: see 'Add at least one artifact.'
The previous goals' specs (e2e/popup-and-manage-access/, e2e/share-ux-fixes/, e2e/smoke.spec.ts) that typed into or read the old textarea are updated to the rows, and all pass

features.description: On an artifact tab, a Manage access icon in the header opens People with access from the Share or the Lists tab, without scrolling, and the old link at the bottom is gone
steps: Save three lists, make https://claude.ai/artifact/ExampleSharedArtifact01 the active tab and open the popup on the Share tab

See, in the header beside the account pill and visible without scrolling, a people icon button named 'Manage access' with the tooltip 'Manage access to this artifact'; scroll to the bottom of the Share tab and see no 'Manage access' link there
Click the icon: see People with access with You (owner), viewer@example.com (Can view), commenter@example.com (Pending, Commenter) and locked@example.com
While it is open, see the icon shown as pressed (aria-pressed=true); click it again and see the Share tab back, as when clicking Back
Paste a second artifact link into Artifacts, open Manage access, click Back: see the Share tab exactly as left, with both rows

Switch to the Lists tab, open a saved list and change its permission without saving, then click the icon: Manage access opens; click Back and see the Lists tab with that list still open and its unsaved permission
Change commenter@example.com to Can view and remove viewer@example.com from this view: both work as before (the existing Manage access e2e specs pass using the header icon)

features.description: The Manage access icon only appears where it works, is easy to use with the keyboard, and fits in the header
steps: Open the popup over a non-claude.ai page, and again over https://claude.ai/ (no artifact open): no Manage access icon and no empty gap where it would be
Open the popup over an artifact tab and press Tab from the top: focus reaches the Manage access icon with a visible focus ring; press Enter and see People with access, with focus on its Back button
Press Back (or Enter on it): the previous tab shows again and focus returns to the Manage access icon
At the popup's 380 px width, see the logo, the wordmark, the account pill and the header icons on one line: the account pill truncates if needed and the icons are never cut off or wrapped

Start a run that sends to this artifact, then click the icon while the run view is showing: People with access opens with the note 'A share is in progress for this artifact. Refresh shows the latest.'
Hover the icon: see the tooltip; in dark mode the icon is as visible as the other header controls

features.description: The extension has a side panel again that shows the same ArtiShare (header, Share and Lists tabs, footer), filling the panel's height
steps: Run `npm run build:fake` and open .output/chrome-mv3-fake/manifest.json: see `side_panel.default_path` pointing at the side panel page, `sidePanel` in `permissions`, `action.default_popup` still the popup page, and the same `key` as before (wxt.config.ts key unchanged)

Open the side panel page (in e2e, sidepanel.html opened as a tab at 400×900): see the ArtiShare header, the account pill reading owner@example.com, the Share and Lists tabs, and 'Version …' at the bottom
See it fill the whole height: header and tabs at the top, the footer at the very bottom, only the content between them scrolling, and no 600 px cap
Make a list, preview and send to one artifact from the side panel: see the run finish ('Share finished: …')
Every existing popup spec still passes

features.description: The popup's 'Open in side panel' icon moves ArtiShare into the side panel, and from then on the toolbar icon opens the side panel
steps: Open the popup: see a header icon button named 'Open in side panel' with that tooltip
Click it: the side panel opens in the current window showing ArtiShare, and the popup closes

Click the ArtiShare toolbar icon again: the side panel opens, not the popup (in e2e: `chrome.action.getPopup({})` returns '' and `chrome.sidePanel.getPanelBehavior()` reports `openPanelOnActionClick: true`, and the stored choice says side panel)
In the side panel, see no 'Open in side panel' icon

features.description: The side panel's 'Use popup instead' icon switches back: the side panel closes and the toolbar icon opens the popup again
steps: With the side panel chosen, open it: see a header icon button named 'Use popup instead' with that tooltip
Click it: the side panel closes
Click the ArtiShare toolbar icon: the popup opens (in e2e: `chrome.action.getPopup({})` ends with popup.html and `openPanelOnActionClick` is false, and the stored choice says popup)
In the popup, see no 'Use popup instead' icon
Switch to the side panel and back twice: each switch leaves the toolbar icon opening the last thing chosen

features.description: The popup-or-side-panel choice survives restarting Chrome and updating the extension, and people coming from 0.3.0 start with the popup
steps: On a fresh install, click the toolbar icon: the popup opens (getPopup returns popup.html, openPanelOnActionClick false)
Choose the side panel, then reload the extension (chrome://extensions ↻; in e2e, `chrome.runtime.reload()` and wait for the new service worker): the toolbar icon still opens the side panel
Choose the popup and reload the extension: the toolbar icon opens the popup
Start from a profile holding 0.3.0's storage (saved lists, a default selection, no stored choice): after loading this build, every list is still there and the toolbar icon opens the popup
Put an unknown value in the stored choice: the toolbar icon opens the popup

features.description: Moving between the popup and the side panel keeps your work: the artifacts, the ticked lists, a list being typed, a preview, a run and the open tab
steps: In the popup, add two artifacts in Share, untick Alpha and tick Beta; switch to Lists, click New list and type a name and one address without saving
Click Open in side panel: see the side panel on the Lists tab with that new-list form, name and address; switch to Share and see the two artifact rows with Beta ticked and Alpha unticked
Click Preview in the side panel, then Use popup instead and open the popup: see the same preview with Back and Send
Click Send and confirm; while it runs, switch to the side panel: see live progress, and Stop then Resume work there; the run is not interrupted by the switch and finishes ('Share finished: …')

features.description: The side panel follows the tab you're on: switching to an artifact tab adds it to Artifacts (unless you removed it), and the 'This tab' badge moves with you
steps: Open the side panel with no artifacts over a non-claude.ai tab: no rows
Switch to https://claude.ai/artifact/ExampleArtifactOne01: within a second a row for it appears with the 'This tab' badge
Switch to https://claude.ai/artifact/ExampleArtifactTwo02: a second row appears, and the badge moves to it
Switch back to One: no new row; the badge moves back to One
Remove Two with ×, switch to a non-claude.ai tab and back to Two: Two is not added again (as in the popup); + Current tab adds it on purpose
Switch to a non-claude.ai tab: no row has the badge and the rows are unchanged
In one claude.ai tab, open a different artifact in place (the URL's ?artifact= changes without a new tab): within a second it is added with the badge
Click + Current tab while on One: it adds nothing new and shows no error, since the tab that is active now (not the one the panel opened over) is already in the list

features.description: In the side panel, the Manage access icon follows the tab you're on, and an open Manage access stays on the artifact it was opened for
steps: Open the side panel over a non-claude.ai tab: no Manage access icon
Switch to https://claude.ai/artifact/ExampleSharedArtifact01: the icon appears; click it and see People with access for that artifact, with its link at the top
With Manage access open, switch to https://claude.ai/artifact/ExampleArtifactTwo02: the view stays on the first artifact (its link still shown) and nothing is changed
Click Back, then the icon: Manage access opens for the second artifact, the tab you're on now
Open Manage access, switch to a non-claude.ai tab: the view stays; click Back and see the icon gone

features.description: If Chrome can't open the side panel, the popup stays open, says why, and the toolbar icon keeps opening the popup
steps: Make `chrome.sidePanel.open` reject (in e2e, replace it in the popup page before clicking) and click Open in side panel: the popup stays open and shows 'Couldn't open the side panel: …' with the reason
See the toolbar icon still opening the popup (getPopup returns popup.html, the stored choice says popup) and the Share form unchanged
Make `chrome.sidePanel` undefined (a Chrome without side panels) and reopen the popup: no Open in side panel icon is shown

features.description: The side panel is comfortable for long lists: it uses the panel's width and height, and nothing scrolls sideways at any width
steps: Open the side panel page at 320, 400 and 600 px wide (900 tall): the content uses the full width (no fixed 380 px column), there is no horizontal scrollbar, and the header's logo, account pill and icons stay on one line
Save a list with 200 addresses and open it in the Lists tab of the side panel at 900 px tall: the address box shows more lines than it does in the popup, and Save is reachable by scrolling
Add 30 artifacts: the rows scroll with the page, each × stays visible and clickable, and links are cut off with … rather than widening the panel
Paste a 120-character address: it wraps or truncates without widening the panel
Open the popup: it is unchanged, 380 px wide and no taller than 600 px

features.description: README, store listing, website and contributor docs describe the side panel choice, the Manage access icon and the Artifacts rows
steps: README: Use it explains Open in side panel and Use popup instead, that the toolbar icon remembers the choice, and that work carries over; Pick artifacts describes the rows, pasting links, the current tab being added with the 'This tab' badge (also on switching tabs in the side panel), × with Undo, and that a removed artifact isn't added back by itself; Optional: Manage access describes the header icon (no 'bottom of the Share tab' wording left)
store/listing.md: the permissions table justifies `sidePanel` again, and the description mentions the side panel option
docs/index.html mentions the side panel option and the Manage access icon
CLAUDE.md's layout names the side panel entrypoint next to popup/
`grep -rn 'bottom of the Share tab' README.md store docs` finds nothing

features.description: The README and store screenshots show the new header icons and Artifacts rows, and a new screenshot shows the side panel with a long list
steps: Run `npm run screenshots`: docs/images/share.png, preview.png, done.png and manage.png show the header with the Manage access and Open in side panel icons, and share.png shows Artifacts as rows with ×
See a new docs/images/sidepanel.png of the side panel with a long list open in the Lists tab, and the README showing it with alt text naming the side panel
store/images screenshots are regenerated the same way, at 1280×800
Every screenshot uses only made-up addresses and artifact ids, and the screenshot e2e checks (sizes, README tags and alt text, made-up ids) pass with the new image
